kind: Conditional arithmetic engineering screen, not measured or manufacturer guaranteed hot limits
sense_screen_basis: Retained existing TME R5/R6 extended tolerance/TCR/life/FB reserve model; use current actual BOM owner figures if changed
frequency_model_limit: CrM triangle toy model. Actual controller line modulation/forced frequency/core loss must be measured;100kHz test frequency is not a maximum operating frequency.
thermal_model_limit: Only copper loss is calculated. Core loss and theta are planning assumptions, not measurements. Retain existing T1 body target90C; conditional58–107C scenarios do not establish thermal closure. Research100C proposal is superseded, not an approved relaxation.
output_current_effect: Nominal sense resistors and controller fixed peak estimate retained, about135.2mA total /133.4mA LED at60V. New L changes switching frequency/current timing, requires retuning/measurement per manufacturer; do not claim optical/current guarantee.
ripple_model_limit: Fulltriangle toy currentoccupancy gives upperplanning estimate, not100Hz outputvoltage ripple or controller actualwaveform.
